sources.title: mohammedaly22/Metro-ASR-Small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description Metro-ASR Small is a 61M parameter non-autoregressive CTC-based ASR model built on a modern Conformer encoder. It is specifically designed for Egyptian Arabic (العامية المصرية) with native Arabic-English code-switching support.

sources.title: Metro-ASR - a Hugging Face Space by mohammedaly22
sources.snippet: Metro-ASR is a non-autoregressive CTC-based ASR system built on a Conformer encoder with: RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, SE-Conv, Stochastic Depth, Intermediate CTC. Trained on 130K+ Egyptian Arabic audio samples with code-switching support. This demo uses the Small model (61,586,320 params) running on CPU. | |

sources.snippet: The language head This is the part of Metro-ASR worth stealing. CTC's per-frame independence produces a specific, recognisable class of error: doubled syllables, dropped affixes, near-homophones, English words half-spelled. These are not acoustic failures. The model heard correctly and wrote something that is not a word.
